stage: P2-58 planner tolerance for diagonal pairs
purpose: Map the longitudinal/lateral pair geometry that the planner may present to the frozen P2-40 cheeks and P2-51 delivery path.

frozen_setup.geometry: P2-40 baseline cheeks, pivot, wheels, nip and rails plus P2-51 R75/42-degree ski and basket
frozen_setup.jam_detector: accepted P2-56 D5065-only detector; unchanged thresholds

matrix.coordinates: centre-to-centre components before contact; pair lateral midpoint is Y=0

lead_ball_sides.lead_plus: first ball at +dy/2, second ball at -dy/2; both tread mu values
lead_ball_sides.lead_minus: first ball at -dy/2, second ball at +dy/2; tread mu 0.6
lead_ball_sides.center: dy=0; mirror-identical and run once per tread mu

matrix.infeasible_cells: sqrt(dx^2+dy^2)<66 mm are reported N/A and are not spawned

classification.PASS: both balls retained in the P2-51 basket
classification.JAM: not both retained and the accepted P2-56 detector or a sustained stationary pair lock triggers
classification.REJECT: not both retained without a physical jam signature

recording.required: rerun headless with state log every JAM/REJECT and every PASS sharing a grid edge with a non-PASS feasible cell

deliverables: classification maps by tread mu and lead-ball side
P2-56 detector trigger status for every physical jam
conservative planner alignment rule supported by all tested orientations and tread friction values
limitations: deterministic Gazebo comparison, not a tolerance or perception-error Monte Carlo
no P2-57 cheeks/covers, STL, 5d or production-stack claim
